effective_training_and_deployment_task_p.description: Trial005 sampling-only retry from trial004's predesignated final checkpoint. Replace last-substep wheel-link vertical-velocity cost with the arithmetic mean over all four refreshed 200 Hz substeps. Weight, normalization, other rewards, reference, PD, friction, motor randomization, contact settings and behavior gates remain unchanged. This corrects reward quadrature, not established contact-model equivalence. Activate only after the actual Isaac runtime smoke passes. Evaluate only the final checkpoint after 600 additional PPO updates; retain any failure. No hardware or statistical robustness claim.

learning_rate_resume_context.evidence_scope: Source-pinned actual startup scalar audit, full CPU budget/tensor proof and paired final-actor provenance; not independent full-minibatch LR telemetry.
limitations: The frozen legacy/012/013 routes are not the explicit combined trial014 publication route.
After initial scalar synchronization, the original adaptive schedule may change LR normally.
Counts and fingerprints are source-backed sampler metadata, not an independent archive of every training tensor or live reward value.
The sealed current-stack eight-environment smoke remains limited fixture evidence, not a full-training or contact-physics equivalence test.
Wheel LINK-origin vertical velocity is not COM velocity or contact-point separation; substep coverage does not establish continuous bearing contact.
The mean squares each native sample before averaging; it is not necessarily larger than the last-sample cost.
Startup audit/source proof does not independently measure every mini-batch learning rate or establish a causal explanation.
One seed and one paired episode do not establish statistical robustness, contact-law equivalence or hardware readiness.

original_training_task_profile.description: Contact-stability retry from trial003's final checkpoint. Add dimensionally scaled leg-target-rate and wheel-link vertical-velocity penalties, providing dense training signals even when Isaac contacts remain supported. The latter is link-origin velocity, not contact-point separation. Preserve the same reference, 50 Hz policy / 200 Hz physics, gains, motor randomization, friction, explicit soft-contact calibration and all acceptance thresholds. Final checkpoint is predesignated after 600 additional updates. No hardware or statistical robustness claim.

learning_rate_resume_context.sampling_profile_provenance: Exact historical005 profile bytes and description are retained; current014 identity and held-fixed LR synchronization are declared separately.

limitations: One first episode per engine; this is not a measured robustness probability.
Contact support and contiguous drift duration use held samples on the actual logged clock.
Near-rest sideslip is undefined and excluded below the fixed speed threshold.
Contact-patch slip must be recorded by each engine; it is never inferred from base velocity.
Canonical 50 Hz Isaac trajectory verifies actor observations; separately hash-verified physical-rate telemetry determines behavior and contact gates.
Legacy Isaac policy-rate records remain inspectable but unequal physical contact sampling is a failed paired gate.
Missing nonwheel contact telemetry leaves complete contact evidence false.
Common-window RMSE is diagnostic and uses no phase shift, spatial alignment or extrapolation.

substep_velocity_sampling_context.formula: mean_s(sum_w((v_link_z_w_s / std_m_s)^2)); square each sample before arithmetic averaging
limitations: Source-backed scalar configuration and sampling-counter metadata, not independent full2048 training tensor/reward archives.
LINK-origin vertical velocity is not COM velocity or actual contact-point separation; correct quadrature does not guarantee load-bearing contact.
Square-before-mean is the original formula; the mean cost can be below the last-substep cost, not necessarily stronger.
The native clock tolerates only declared float32 callback-dt rounding and eight double ULPs; no counter gaps or reset samples are bridged.
Unmasked native/tensor CUDA ordinal readback is not physical UUID mapping, exclusive resource reservation or hardware readiness.
